snippet.title: Roll The Bones - Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into this fast-paced roguelite where magic spell-dice are your deadliest weapons. Explore deep dungeons, find powerful spell combinations and unleash absolute chaos!

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527550/Roll_The_Bones/

🔵 Steam Early Access launch: July 28th, 2026
🔵 Developer: Shrimp Industries
🔵 Publisher: Proteus Interactive

Let's roll some bones!
